items.title: UPS (UPS) Stock Looks 47% Undervalued On Future Cash Flow
items.summary: United Parcel Service shares have climbed over the past year even though holders over the last 5 years have seen a sizeable decline. This puts the focus squarely on what the current price is asking investors to pay for the company’s cash flows. With the stock around US$108.51 at the last close, the core question is how well that valuation lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. items.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Investors Can Now Claim From $45 Million SEC Fair Fund
items.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) reached an SEC settlement creating a US$45m Fair Fund for certain investors in UPS securities. The SEC found UPS failed to properly record goodwill impairment for its UPS Freight unit, leading to misstated earnings figures. Investors who bought UPS shares or specified bonds between October 2019 and January 2021 may now submit claims to the Fair Fund.
